install_steps: CILIUM_CLI_VERSION=$(curl -s https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cilium/cilium-cli/main/stable.txt) && curl -L --remote-name-all https://github.com/cilium/cilium-cli/releases/download/${CILIUM_CLI_VERSION}/cilium-linux-amd64.tar.gz && tar xzvf cilium-linux-amd64.tar.gz && mkdir -p ~/.local/bin && mv cilium ~/.local/bin/
note: Also available via Homebrew (brew install cilium-cli), Krew (kubectl krew install cilium), or apt/rpm packages published on the releases page. For arm64 replace amd64 with arm64 in the tarball name.
